name: Lenol
what_they_do: Lagos-based distributed energy infrastructure startup (Lenol Tech Inc., co-founded by Samuel Orji) building solar-powered Powershops for battery rental, battery swapping, and productive energy access for Nigerian SMEs, market traders, and electric mobility riders.
recent_activity: 2026-11-19: Selected for $100K equity investment under BOI/iDICE Startup Bridge Growth Lab (https://www.startuplist.africa/funding/lenol-equity-investment-100k-usd-21e9d21); 2026-11-23: Featured among 8 iDICE Growth Lab recipients (https://weetracker.com/2026/11/23/8-nigerian-startups-get-800000-idice-growth-lab/); 2026-06-02: Published generator cost guide on Lenol Journal (https://www.lenol.co/blog/guides/cost-of-running-a-generator-in-nigeria)
round_type: iDICE Startup Bridge Growth Lab Equity
investors: Bank of Industry (BOI) / iDICE Startup Bridge (AfDB, AFD, IsDB)
marketing_titles_found: NONE (homepage The Team section lists only Infrastructure & Operations, Fintech & Payments, Mobility & EV, and Technology Platform capabilities with no named team or marketing/growth titles)
hiring_marketing_role: NO (footer Careers link routes to https://lenol.co/# with no open marketing/growth roles)
unique_offer: Solar-powered market Powershops combining pay-per-use portable battery rentals for SMEs and 90-second e-bike battery swaps on a single shared operational software network.
